• DPSP are in Part IV (Articles 36–51).
• Fundamental Duties are in Part IVA (Article 51A).
• DPSP inspired by Irish Constitution.
• Fundamental Duties inspired by Soviet Constitution.
• Uniform Civil Code – Article 44.

items: Constitutional origins are frequently asked: DPSP comes from the Irish Constitution, while Fundamental Duties come from the Soviet Constitution.
Pay attention to constitutional parts: DPSP is in Part IV, whereas Fundamental Duties are in Part IVA.
Articles 44 (Uniform Civil Code) and 48A (Environment Protection) are extremely high-yield targets in match-the-following questions.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) are located in Part IV (Articles 36–51) and inspired by the Irish Constitution.
Fundamental Duties are contained in Part IVA under Article 51A and were inspired by the Soviet Constitution.
Article 44 specifically outlines the provisions for a Uniform Civil Code.
Article 48A deals with the protection and improvement of the environment.
